children: Alexander E. Anderson is announced as a Senior Vice President, Private Banker of

. Mr. Anderson brings more than 15 years of experience in business development, strategic advisory services and family office management, with deep expertise serving high-net-worth individuals, family offices, institutional investors, asset managers and business leaders.

“We are excited to welcome Alex Anderson to our Private Banking team,” said Kerri Mooney, Executive Vice President of Private Banking for Eastern Bank. “Alex's experience advising family offices, entrepreneurs and institutional investors across global markets, combined with his relationship-focused approach and strategic perspective, will bring added value to our clients and our team’s commitment to delivering highly personalized financial solutions.”

Mr. Anderson most recently served as Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Impact Strategic Partners, where he led strategic consulting engagements focused on investment management, strategic partnerships and business development. Prior to that, he founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of AEA Capital Partners, an advisory firm serving family offices globally in such areas as cross-border investment and capital deployment strategies. Earlier in his career, he worked as an advisor for several ultra high net worth family offices with a focus on investment management, due diligence, tax, trust and estate planning. Mr. Anderson attended Pepperdine University for his undergraduate education and subsequently studied at Harvard Business School in the Owner/President Management Program. In the community, he holds several advisory and volunteer roles with organizations including the Dream Center Foundation, World Relief and International Rescue Committee.

“I'm honored to join the Cambridge Trust Private Banking team, and look forward to helping clients navigate opportunities, preserve wealth, and achieve their personal, philanthropic and business goals,” said Alex Anderson, Senior Vice President, Private Banker of Cambridge Trust Private Banking.

Cambridge Trust Private Banking, a Division of Eastern Bank, offers more than just financial services—it provides a personalized banking experience that understands an individual’s unique needs, priorities and values. Whether in the early stage of a career, the mainstream of building wealth, or the preparation of transferring wealth, private bankers help individuals reach their goals. Recognizing personal and professional financial needs are often interconnected, the team also works with a range of companies and organizations, including multi-generational businesses, to address their private banking goals.

Founded in 1818, Eastern Bank is Greater Boston’s leading local bank with more than 125 branch locations serving communities in eastern Massachusetts, southern and coastal New Hampshire, and Rhode Island. As of June 30, 2026, Eastern had approximately $31.1 billion in assets. Eastern provides a full range of banking and wealth management solutions for consumers and businesses of all sizes including through its Cambridge Trust Wealth Management and Private Banking Divisions, which include the largest bank-owned independent investment adviser in Massachusetts with $10.6 billion in assets under management. Eastern takes pride in its advocacy and community support that includes more than $240 million in charitable giving since 1994.
